parallels.note: Then he said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch with me.”

translations.web: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch.”
translations.bsb: Then He said to them, “My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch.”
translations.kjv: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
translations.asv: And he saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful even unto death: abide ye here, and watch.
